airports.csv.note: Published from a rolling branch, so this one is pinned by checksum rather than by commit. A checksum mismatch means upstream changed — re-record deliberately and re-verify the matched rows.

recordHistory.reason: upstream rolling branch advanced (85,946 -> 85,954 rows). Re-recorded only after verifying that all 18 ICAO idents consumed by build_coordinates.py (19 locations; Mulhouse and Bale share LFSB) are byte-identical between the two versions, so no coordinate changes. Verified fields: ident, name, latitude_deg, longitude_deg, iso_country, type.
